limitations: The corpus is strictly constrained to the static offline documentation set and schema specifications published in documentation/ and source.json; runtime F5 Distributed Cloud API behaviors and live tenant validations are not represented.

Prompts intentionally paraphrase terminology and omit exact Terraform resource identifiers while retaining sufficient product and role semantics to achieve unambiguous destination resolution for answerable queries.
Provider setup queries target human-oriented markdown argument reference sections rather than schema attribute anchors due to absence of machine-readable schema metadata in provider/setup/index.md.

Controls represent realistic discovery queries for features supported in broader cloud ecosystem tooling (e.g. AWS IAM assume-role, WireGuard keys, Helm repository URLs) that are unsupported in the xcsh provider schema.
